Earth equatorial diameter is about 12,756 km
About 30.1 Earth diameters fit in the average gap

captions.twitter:
The Moon is not "right next to" Earth.

At the average distance, about 30 Earths fit in the gap.

384,400 km ÷ 12,756 km ≈ 30.1 — math, not a compressed diagram.
captions.instagram:
Most textbook diagrams compress this distance beyond recognition. At the mean Earth–Moon gap, about 30 Earth diameters fit between them.

Sources: NASA Moon & Earth fact sheets
#spacefacts #visualscience #dataviz
captions.tiktok: The Moon looks close because diagrams cheat. Divide NASA's mean distance by Earth's diameter and roughly 30 Earths fit in the gap. #space #nasa #scale
